📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Lateral vs total surface area?
Lateral is just the curved side (2πrh); total adds the two circular bases.
Why is volume πr²h?
The base area πr² stacked h units high gives the volume.
Does it work for hollow tubes?
No — this is a solid cylinder. Subtract an inner cylinder’s volume for a tube.
